北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴朗，体感 -5℃ 较冷，记得多添衣物保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny but feels like -5℃. Remember to dress warmly!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪多云，体感 -2℃ 仍冷，外出注意防寒，小心着凉。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy, feels like -2℃. Stay warm when you go out to avoid catching a cold.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云，体感 -1℃ 寒意浓，记得加件外套再出门！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy, feels like -1℃. Remember to wear a jacket when you go out!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，体感 6℃ 略凉，带伞以防小雨，注意保暖。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is overcast, feels like 6℃, a bit cool. Bring an umbrella and stay warm.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，体感 8℃ 湿度高，出行记得带伞，小心湿冷。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is overcast, feels like 8℃ with high humidity. Bring an umbrella and be wary of the damp cold.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州多云，体感 0℃ 需保暖，多穿点，别让寒意钻空子！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hanzhou is cloudy, feels like 0℃. Dress warmly to keep the cold out!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴朗，体感 -1℃ 依然冷，暖和穿搭，保持好心情。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny, feels like -1℃, still cold. Dress warmly and keep a good mood.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 5℃ 稍凉，别忘添衣，小心风寒感冒。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast, feels like 5℃, a bit cool. Don't forget extra layers to avoid colds.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云，体感 0℃ 湿冷，注意防风保暖，多喝热水。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy, feels like 0℃ with damp cold. Stay warm, protect from wind, and drink more hot water.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴好，体感 1℃ 凉爽，出门注意防风，多加衣物。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and pleasant, feels like 1℃. Be mindful of the wind and layer up.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 6℃ 有些凉，湿度高，注意防潮保暖。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast, feels like 6℃, a bit cool with high humidity. Stay warm and dry.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴朗，体感 -26℃ 极寒，务必全副武装，注意防冻！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny but extremely cold at -26℃. Dress warmly from head to toe to prevent frostbite!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -26℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴天，体感 -19℃ 寒风凛冽，出门记得戴帽手套。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny and bitterly cold at -19℃. Remember your hat and gloves when going out.
沈阳.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -19℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阳光正好，体感 12℃ 舒适，早晚温差大，注意加减衣物。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and feels comfortable at 12℃. Mind the big temperature difference between morning and night.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，体感 5℃ 稍凉，风力 3级，出门添衣防风。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, feels a bit cool at 5℃ with a 3-level wind. Layer up and protect from wind.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感 -6℃ 风大寒冷，外出务必穿厚保暖哦！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and feels very cold at -6℃ with strong winds. Dress very warmly when you go out!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴朗，体感 -11℃ 冰冷，防寒保暖工作要做足哦！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny but icy cold at -11℃. Make sure to do enough to stay warm!
